name: UBTECH Walker S2
summary: A 1.76 m walking industrial humanoid with two dexterous hands that swaps its own battery and lifts up to 15 kg, orderable in Germany from RobotShop Europe or through Terra Robotics.

priceEur.note: RobotShop Europe price shown with VAT for Germany; kit includes two Gen-4 dexterous hands, charging station and two batteries.

germany.leadTime: RobotShop: on-demand item, ordered from the supplier; due date shown at checkout

sellers.name: RobotShop Europe (RobotShop inc., eu.robotshop.com)
sellers.note: On-demand item (not stocked) with add-to-cart and quote request; manufacturer no. Walker-S2-Kit.

sellers.name: Terra Robotics (Terra Connect GmbH)
sellers.note: Product page shows "Preis anfragen"; the page metadata carries EUR 192,437 without stating VAT, not displayed to buyers. Two Gen-4 dexterous hands are a separate listing (EUR 25,126 in metadata).

germany.statusNote: RobotShop Europe lists the Walker S2 with two Gen-4 dexterous hands at EUR 238,000 incl. VAT as an on-demand item with delivery to Germany; Terra Robotics, UBTECH's exclusive DACH distributor, quotes on request.

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: 44 active + 8 passive with Gen-4 hands; 30 active without hands

specs.label: Payload, both arms
specs.conditions: maximum; UBTECH states 15 kg within a 0-1.8 m workspace

specs.label: Single-hand grasp
specs.conditions: Gen-4 hand, whole-hand grasp; finger grasp 1 kg

specs.label: Max walking speed
specs.conditions: unloaded; loaded walking up to 2.5 km/h

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: at least 3.5 h in stepping mode (100-0 %); at least 2 h in transport mode (100-20 %), test values

specs.label: Autonomous battery swap
specs.conditions: swaps its own battery in about 3 minutes at a swap station

specs.label: Charging time
specs.conditions: full charge in the robot; 10-90 % under 2.5 h

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: Intel i7-1185G7 + NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64 GB (275 TOPS)

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: 4 x 1 MP cameras, 2 x RGB-D, binocular stereo head, 2 x IMU, 2 x 6-axis force sensors

notes: 15 kg is the payload for both arms together; UBTECH gives no per-arm figure.
RobotShop's kit includes two Gen-4 dexterous hands; Terra lists the hands (2 pieces) as a separate product and its S2 scope of delivery names robot, flight case, display stand and charging station.
No IP rating, stair or outdoor rating published.
